name: Throne of Blood
source:
James Miller is a crime lord who is tired of being in the shadow of William Smith and wants to take over. Emilia Smith is the elder daughter of William. She wants to make sure that she inherits the throne when he retires, as she has to face the ambition of her step-sister and her mother.

Will they be able to achieve their goals? What alliances, mixed with erotic encounters, will they need to do to eventually gain control over their common objective: to control the Throne of Blood?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/lestarstudios/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
詹姆斯·米勒是一名犯罪头目，他厌倦了威廉·史密斯的阴影，想要接管。艾米莉亚·史密斯是威廉的大女儿。她想确保在他退休后她继承王位，因为她必须面对继姐和母亲的野心。

他们能够实现他们的目标吗？他们需要采取什么样的联盟，再加上色情遭遇，才能最终控制他们的共同目标：控制鲜血王座？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/lestarstudios/about]Patreon[/url]]
